places.name: .pk.json
places.says: The project config. The changelog and release sections hold the hooks, the types table, the version files and release.branch.

places.name: working branch
places.says: The branch the run is made from. HEAD is its last commit. In trunk flow the page calls it the default branch.

places.name: release branch
places.says: release.branch: the branch releases merge into, in merge flow.

places.name: version files
places.says: changelog.versionFiles names JSON files whose root version field is spliced in place.

places.name: a hook's own changes
places.says: Whatever a changelog hook's command changes in the tree. The page says only that a failure puts it back.

places.name: the commits
places.says: The conventional commits since the last version tag, less the excluded ones.

places.name: the release's name
places.says: The version and tag read from the Release-Tag trailer on HEAD.

facts.name: dry run
facts.says: --dry-run is given

facts.name: undo
facts.says: --undo is given

facts.name: --bump is given
facts.says: --bump major|minor|patch overrides the inference

facts.name: --exclude is given
facts.says: --exclude drops commits by short hash before bump inference

facts.name: merge flow
facts.says: release.branch set selects merge flow; empty selects trunk flow.

facts.name: there are no local tags
facts.says: A clone with no local tags: a fresh clone that fetched only the working branch.

facts.name: no version tag exists
facts.says: No version tag means nothing has been released. Here it is so after origin's tags were fetched.

facts.name: version files are configured
facts.says: changelog.versionFiles is not empty; default none.

facts.name: a postVersion hook is set
facts.says: changelog.hooks.postVersion; default none.

facts.name: a preCommit hook is set
facts.says: changelog.hooks.preCommit; default none.

facts.name: a preRelease hook is set
facts.says: release.hooks.preRelease; default none.

facts.name: a prePush hook is set
facts.says: release.hooks.prePush; default none.

facts.name: the preRelease hook commits
facts.says: A preRelease hook that commits produces a commit the tag then covers.

facts.name: HEAD carries a Release-Tag trailer
facts.says: pk changelog commits with a Release-Tag trailer; pk release reads it on HEAD.

facts.name: .pk.json does not load
facts.says: An unknown key or a value outside these fails the whole file when it loads.

facts.name: the --bump value is not major, minor or patch
facts.says: Any other --bump value is refused as a usage error.

facts.name: HEAD is on a protected branch
facts.says: Run it from the working branch. A protected branch is refused.

facts.name: HEAD is detached
facts.says: No branch is checked out.

facts.name: the last version tag is not in the branch's history
facts.says: A branch rewritten after a release.

facts.name: an excluded hash matches no commit
a version file cannot be stamped
facts.says: A version file fails.

facts.name: the Release-Tag trailer is not valid
facts.says: --undo refuses unless HEAD carries a valid Release-Tag trailer. The release page speaks only of no trailer.

facts.name: the branch is not on origin
facts.says: Pre-flight: a branch checked out, on origin.

facts.name: the branch is behind origin
facts.says: Pre-flight: not behind it.

facts.name: the release branch cannot be resolved
facts.says: Pre-flight: release branch resolvable.

facts.name: the branch checked out is not the default branch
facts.says: Trunk flow refuses to run anywhere else.

facts.name: the preRelease hook fails
facts.says: The page names the hook and does not say what a failure of it does. It runs before the tag exists, and rollback is said of a failure after tagging.

facts.name: a changelog dry run fetches origin's tags
facts.says: pk changelog fetches origin's tags first. --dry-run prints without writing or committing. The page does not say whether a dry run fetches.

facts.name: a changelog dry run runs the hooks
facts.says: The changelog page does not say whether --dry-run runs postVersion and preCommit.

facts.name: the preCommit hook runs before CHANGELOG.md is written
facts.says: preCommit runs before the release commit. The page does not say on which side of writing CHANGELOG.md.

facts.name: pre-flight fetches origin's tags
facts.says: Pre-flight fetches from origin to make these checks. The page does not say whether tags are fetched as well as the branch.

facts.name: the preRelease hook runs before the merge
facts.says: preRelease runs before the tag exists. The page does not say on which side of the fast-forward.

facts.name: a rehearsed preRelease hook makes its changes
facts.says: preRelease is rehearsed by --dry-run. The page does not say whether a hook that commits has committed after a rehearsal.

expects.name: pk changelog creates no git tag
expects.because: No git tag is created; pk release creates it.

expects.name: a changelog dry run writes nothing and commits nothing
expects.because: --dry-run: print the section to stdout without writing or committing.

expects.name: an undo dry run changes nothing
expects.because: With --dry-run it makes the same checks, says what it would unwind, and changes nothing.

expects.name: a bad --bump value generates nothing
expects.when: the --bump value is not major, minor or patch
expects.because: Any other --bump value is refused as a usage error, and nothing is generated.

expects.because: When a version file or a hook fails, nothing is committed and the tree goes back to how the run found it, a hook's own changes included.

rules.rule: A breaking change (type!: or a BREAKING CHANGE: footer) bumps major, feat bumps minor, anything else bumps patch.
--bump major|minor|patch overrides the inference, and the run names the override next to the version it generates: Generating v0.8.1 (--bump patch; the commits infer minor).
--exclude drops commits by short hash before bump inference.
